body: Independent review found str.splitlines counted vertical tabs as record delimiters. Corrected in the single batch to binary LF-delimited records. The added needle\vneedle\n case failed before correction; final four-module run passes 41 tests (one inherited missing canonical-task skip).

Independent review found UV flag assertions could pass without any observed launch. Corrected hostile config bytes and required dependency/cache access plus a nonempty observed UV launch list. Final test source fails all 12 selectors against unchanged 8a09b936 and passes in the final four-module run.

The online PyYAML-only cache seed and named provisioning skip comply with the authoritative 2026-10-19T11:46:17Z dispatch interpretation. Initial provisioning candidate withdrawn. No P0/P1 identified in the one independent pre-push review; final CI and deployment were not reviewed.
